steps.what: Retrieve the actual current class roster and attendance session
Take class attendance by checking actual student presence and resolving uncertain identity or arrival status
Enter and check the actual attendance observations in the existing class attendance record
Save the actual class attendance record in the same working system

tasks.design: Configure the current-session roster view and existing attendance form in the pupil records system {OTHER}. Keep actual presence checking, uncertain cases and factual entry with the assistant; no attendance is inferred and ordinary persistence earns no saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated roster/session navigation and entry headings can add work around the actual roll call.
tasks.enabler_now: Native current-session views and existing form fields can remove those repeated operations.
tasks.still_hard: Presence, late arrival and identity uncertainty require direct checking.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant knows which pupil is actually present and investigates uncertainty.

ambition.what: The same attendance record remains based on actual presence.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: current-session roster views and attendance forms can reduce navigation and repeated fields without determining presence.

assumptions: {OTHER} is the existing pupil attendance system and physical classroom. Boundary includes roll call and the actual working attendance record, not a statutory attendance return or automatic parent message. Any such formal send needs its own release action.

The existing class administrator supplies pupil ID/name, class membership and effective dates; the real timetable supplies session/date. s1 retains reading and missing-roster fallback. s2 produces actual presence/status observations and s3 retains manual factual capture, uncertainty resolution and full identity/date/status checks. No camera, sensor or free structured presence input is assumed.

Test native views/forms first. s1 removes3 of10 repeated roster/session navigation units, retaining7; s3 removes5.1 of34 repeated session/header and field-navigation units, retaining28.9 for actual entry/checks. Existing native features earn no new benefit. Shares are unmeasured estimates.

s4 is a near-zero ordinary same-system author save at the minimum share, fully retained, ungated and without gain. The record is actually read by class staff. Additional view/form repair beyond case checks is counted below; no invented manual tallies or extra report is added.
research_questions: Observe roster retrieval, presence checking and record entry separately.
Test changed class membership and late arrival without inferring presence or creating a message.

already_counted.description: Roster reading, direct presence checking, actual entry/checks and ordinary persistence remain in s1-s4.

incremental.description: Maintain roster/session views and form fields and repair changed references beyond retained attendance checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=7+55+28.9+1=91.9. Gross8.1 less1.5 upkeep gives6.6. Conservative case: a changed class/session needs9.5 of10 lookup units and exceptional arrival statuses retain33 of34 entry units. The1.5 gross gain just covers upkeep; actual presence checks remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare outlines and submit for teacher review

steps.what: Read the assigned subject requirements and teacher guidance for the lesson outlines
Prepare the actual lesson outlines and plans from the assigned subject sources

loop.purpose: Draft the assigned outline structure and wording from the actual teacher requirements and provided sources.
loop.input: Teacher assignment, supplied subject references and existing assistant notes.
loop.output: Draft outline with objective/source references and explicit questions for teacher review.
loop.check: Assistant checks each content statement, objective mapping and access assumption against sources; teacher retains educational review after submission.
loop.stop: Unsupported content or conflicting guidance stops for manual rewrite after at most two drafts.
loop.why_not_simpler: Varied lesson wording needs composition; reuse templates and existing plans wherever adequate.

steps.what: Check the exact final outline submission, teacher recipient and unresolved questions before sending it for review
Submit the exact final lesson outlines to the assigned teacher for review
Review the submitted lesson outlines under the teacher's actual instructional responsibility

tasks.design: Use native {DOCS} outline templates and a bounded wording draft from actual teacher guidance, then deliver the exact checked submission via {EMAIL}. The teacher's educational review follows submission and remains intact; the assistant's send check does not approve the lesson for teaching.
tasks.previous_blocker: The assistant must compose an outline and manually assemble its actual teacher-review submission.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded source-based drafting and deterministic delivery can address those separate actions.
tasks.still_hard: Subject accuracy, access and educational suitability require the assistant's checks and the teacher's actual review.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant flags uncertainty and the teacher decides whether the plan is educationally suitable.

ambition.what: Prepare the same outline for the teacher's actual review.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source-bound drafting and exact-version delivery can support lesson-outline preparation without replacing teacher review.

assumptions: Boundary includes the explicit preparation and submission, with the real teacher review shown as other-role work. The teacher assignment supplies subject, objective, source version and required access constraints. s1 counts reading/extraction; s2 retains actual note capture and draft correction; no free new brief is assumed.

Test existing templates and native review-request functions first. s2 retains22.5 of50 drafting units and removes27.5 repeated first-draft composition units; s3 retains all final factual/submission checks. s4 removes only real manual recipient/attachment/review-request assembly and sending where present today; existing runtime and ordinary file saves earn no gain. Estimates are unmeasured.

a1 binds the exact final submission and intended teacher in s3. It authorizes delivery for review, not the assistant's approval of her own educational work. Content/recipient changes void it. The teacher's real educational review occurs only after submission in s5, fully retained; any later classroom release is a different action.

Ordinary working persistence inside s2 is near-zero, retained and ungated. Additional source packaging and failed-draft/delivery repair are counted below; other-role review is not deducted twice or expanded unpaid.
research_questions: Trace actual preparation and submission through the teacher review.
Test changed content after the send check and a failed submission; retain repair and exact-version authorization.

already_counted.description: Source reading, actual note capture/correction and all final submission checks remain in s1-s3.
Actual teacher educational review remains other-role work excluded from the assistant denominator.

incremental.description: Additional source packaging, template upkeep and failed-draft/submission repairs beyond retained assistant checks.

approvals.approved_version: Exact s3-checked outline, unresolved questions and assigned teacher recipient for review; any change voids delivery authorization.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Focal B=90, R=15+22.5+20=57.5. Gross36.1111 less4 upkeep gives32.1111, high rounded down to32. Teacher review is excluded from B. Conservative case: unfamiliar subject/access requirements retain47 of50 draft units while the real5-unit review submission still automates. Eight/90*100 less4=4.8888, low rounded down to4.8; all reading and final checks remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the actual student progress observations and teacher's parent-conference context
Participate in the teacher-parent conference about the student's actual progress or problems

tasks.design: Link existing dated progress references in the pupil records system {OTHER} and {DOCS}. The assistant retains reading and the actual conference contribution; no extra conference report or automated parent message is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant observation references can be scattered across the existing record.
tasks.enabler_now: A native dated view can remove repeated navigation.
tasks.still_hard: Sensitive discussion, parent understanding and the limits of observations require people.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant contributes actual observations and listens to the parent's perspective.

ambition.what: The same teacher-parent discussion retains human participation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: dated observation views can reduce conference preparation navigation, without replacing a sensitive parent discussion.

assumptions: {OTHER} is the existing pupil records system and actual conference setting. Boundary is the assistant's real preparation and participation. Do not assume this participant authors the teacher's formal conference record; add a real write only if that duty actually exists.

Existing observation authors supply pupil ID, date, observation and source reference; the teacher supplies real conference context. s1 counts reading, source checks and manual fallback; s2 all contribution. No new summary, transcription or structured parent profile is assumed.

Try native dated views first. s1 removes3 of15 repeated navigation units and retains12 for reading; all85 conversation units stay. Estimates are unmeasured. No automated pupil decision or written external send is hidden in the live discussion; source-link repair beyond case reading is counted below.
unknowns: Actual assistant record-writing duty, if any
research_questions: Observe what the assistant actually reads, contributes and is required to write during a real conference.

already_counted.description: Progress source reading and all conference participation remain in s1-s2.

incremental.description: Maintain dated observation references and repair broken links beyond normal conference preparation.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=12+85=97. Gross3 less1 upkeep gives2. Conservative case: archived observations retain14 of15 lookup units; the1-unit gain only covers upkeep, with discussion unchanged.

steps.what: Assist librarians by clarifying the actual library user's request and existing borrower information under their guidance
outputs: understood library request and borrower context

steps.what: Locate the requested library materials using the existing catalog and shelf references
inputs: understood library request and borrower context
outputs: checked catalog item and shelf references

steps.what: Retrieve or shelve the actual library materials and check the exact item's condition and loan eligibility
inputs: checked catalog item and shelf references
understood library request and borrower context

steps.what: Record the actual eligible library loan or return against the checked item and borrower
inputs: understood library request and borrower context

tasks.design: Use the school-library catalog's {OTHER} native item and shelf views for actual lookup. Keep user assistance, physical retrieval/shelving, condition and eligibility checks, and the real circulation transaction human; no saving is assigned to an already native barcode transaction.
tasks.previous_blocker: Catalog item, shelf and availability references can require repeated navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native saved catalog views can shorten that reference search.
tasks.still_hard: Actual item condition, shelf placement, user needs and loan exceptions require the assistant and librarian.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant helps the actual user and notices when the librarian must resolve an exception.

ambition.what: The same librarian-directed assistance remains human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native library catalog views can reduce item-reference navigation, while physical handling and actual circulation checks remain human.

assumptions: The representative assistance episode includes real school-library circulation and shelving under librarian guidance. {OTHER} is the existing library catalog/circulation system and physical library. No extra book-use log or report is invented.

The existing catalog owner supplies item ID, title, shelf and current recorded availability; the existing borrower record supplies borrower ID and recorded loan conditions. s1 counts actual user/borrower checks; s2 source reading and manual missing-reference lookup; s3 all physical handling and exact-item checks. No new clean catalog or location dataset is supplied for free.

Test native catalog views first. s2 removes8 of20 repeated screen-navigation units and retains12 for reading/checking. s4 retains all actual item/borrower scan/capture and transaction work: existing native barcode runtime and ordinary persistence earn no saving. All shares are unmeasured estimates.

a1 is the assistant's real current exact-item/borrower eligibility check under existing librarian rules in s3, not self-approval of a written note. Changed item, borrower, condition or eligibility voids it; exceptions go to the librarian within retained handling work. Ordinary same-system persistence within s4 stays ungated and near-zero; the operational circulation transaction alone carries the gate.
Additional catalog-view upkeep and broken-reference repair beyond case checks are counted below. No new librarian data cleanup is transferred unpaid.
unknowns: Actual library duties and native catalog views
research_questions: Observe librarian-directed assistance and distinguish catalog lookup, physical handling and real circulation entry.
Test a wrong borrower, damaged item and unavailable catalog reference without assuming a loan can proceed.

already_counted.description: User help, catalog reading, all physical handling and eligibility checks, and actual circulation entry remain in s1-s4.

incremental.description: Maintain native catalog/shelf views and repair broken references beyond normal item handling and checking.

approvals.approved_version: Exact physically checked item and borrower under current loan/return conditions in s3; any changed item, borrower or eligibility voids the operational authorization.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=15+12+45+20=92. Gross8 less1.5 upkeep gives6.5. Conservative case: an unindexed edition needs18.5 of20 catalog units; the1.5 gain just covers upkeep. Physical handling and native circulation transactions remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The assistant keeps actual observation, pupil interaction and librarian-directed handling, with native forms and carefully checked drafts reducing specific repeated tasks.
skills_to_grow: Separate direct observations from record navigation
Keep teacher review after the actual outline submission
Check exact item and borrower before a circulation transaction
role.ambitious_version: Support teachers and librarians with accurate records and useful prepared material while retaining their educational and service responsibilities.
